mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_project_agent ( project_id, user_id, name, role, system_prompt, tools, model, temperature, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{role}, #{systemPrompt}, #{tools}, #{model}, #{temperature}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_project_agent SET name = #{name}, role = #{role}, system_prompt = #{systemPrompt}, tools = #{tools}, model = #{model}, temperature = #{temperature}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, user_id, name, role, system_prompt, tools, model, temperature, status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_project_agent WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
